name: e.PN Virtual Standard Grade Card
summary: Entry-level virtual prepaid card designed for solo media buyers to test BIN efficacy on major ad networks.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the e.PN Virtual Standard Grade Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$2.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the e.PN Virtual Standard Grade Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the e.PN Virtual Standard Grade Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
